notes.title: v1.03 Patch Notes! Hall of Fame + Single Player AI
notes.content:
Here's the patch notes for v1.03! 

Major Features
- The Hall of Fame can be accessed via the main menu in-game! Each patch, players who score well in leaderboards will be mentioned there. We also have a [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC4Mr4Et139K13sO3do0uZzQ]youtube channel[/url] in which some of the playthroughs will be recorded and shown there.
- Single Player AI is available! For players who can't micro a party of heroes even with pausing, your ranged heroes will be able to automate the usage of some of their abilities. For example, the priestess will be able to automatically cast Hallowed Heal on injured allies close by. However, usage of the AI mode will add +5 pause points to your score when uploaded.

Tweaks + Content
- 3 New Items! 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30550261/c964adb72b94e3cfbaafe1b32719989173c5a1f0.png[/img]
Mana Gloves
+18 Ability Damage
+2 Mana Regen
-7.5% mana cost reduction to abilities
Credits: NFWar

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30550261/e56cfb3948b142e156c10e11dd6e903167afb9d0.png[/img]
Spellblade
+15 Damage
+3.5% Attack Speed
+2 Mana Regen
+200 Health
+15 Ability Damage
Credits: NFWar

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30550261/ae9bcecaf3406d648991faab1aec1ccf91bf4fe7.png[/img]
Power Fist
+8.5% attack speed
+15 Damage
+200 Health
The Guardian's Thunder Clap ability now knocks enemies back.
Credits: PeeKay

- Tactical Pausing has text changes telling players that each pause reduces their potential gold rewards.
- Quebrach the Spirit Oak Mother now no longer takes damage thanks to barkskin(previously reduced to 99%). Treants Sacrificing/Exploding near it will put a stack of Weakened Soul on it.
- The Deadly Boss Machine's ultimate on hard mode has pattern changes and major tweaks. Electric balls now move during this phase.
- Fujin the Wind Demon's ultimate in hard mode has received minor tweaks.
- Balazar the Necromancer's Spirit Drain now has a cutoff range and speed reduction applied that varies based on difficulty.
- Count Winkus's projectiles are now slower based on player count, do more damage and bypass armor on Impossible Difficulty. His Lightning Strikes now scale based on player count. 
- The number of attacks Gravenous the Brute's does before using his Pummel ability has been increased.
- Madrona the Dragon Matriarch(Hard difficulty) dragon bombs no longer damage friendly units.
- Dragon whelp hit points have been increased.
- Mana Horrors now attack the players after accumulating a number of stacked buffs (hard mode).
- Void Tear AOE intervals has been reduced to 3 from 4.
- Summon Flame pillars now spawn based on player count.
- Ji'loch the Imprisoned's ultimate damage has been increased.
- Boss loot table adjustments.
- Boss hp/damage tweaks in Impossible difficulty.
- Heroes now auto-attack if an enemy is within their sight range.
- You may now transfer items to other heroes by 'dropping' items on them (ala War3).

Fixes
- Desync during the Quebrach encounter fixed.
- Fixed pause input when viewing replays with impossible difficulty.
- Party Portrait mouseover text fix.

This is a major patch; hopefully all the desync problems have been fixed with this. Have fun!

notes.title: NEO Impossible Bosses v1.01 Patch Notes!
notes.content:
Hi all! Here are the patch notes for NEO Impossible Bosses v1.01!

Changes:

- Desync detection is now implemented. The game will be able to detect a desync across all players; and when it does so it will stop the game and let the host pick retry or return to hub. Desyncs are nasty bugs for me to fix, please try to make a post (with the replays attached) in the forums with information on what you were doing before the desync happened!

- The Auto-Attack frequency of boss encounters will now scale based on the number of players. ie. The boss will use abilities more frequently if there are more players in game.
Encounters tweaked:
: Deadly Boss Machine, Madrona The Dragon Matriarch, Ji'loch the Imprisoned, Arimas the One-Eyed Horror, The Twin Frost Elementals.
- Arimas the One-Eyed Horror: The Void Tear ability and Extinguish ability now restore health to the boss, giving it a fresh feel.
- Madrona The Dragon Matriarch: The boss's attacks now apply a debuff called 'Armor Break', which reduces the hit unit's Armor (stacks!). Some abilities have damage values tweaked.
- Ji'loch the Imprisoned: Binding duration changed to 8/5/3 seconds(based on difficulty) and Binding cooldown changed to 60 seconds. Some abilities have damage values tweaked.
- Some status effects that occur will no longer trigger when target is invulnerable.
- Maximum boss minion count reduced to 32.
- Priestess: 
Hallowed Heal mana cost changed to 20 from 15.
Healing Spirit mana cost changed to 35 from 18.
Holy Nova mana cost changed to 30 from 20.
- Paladin:
Matyr mana cost changed to 90 from 70.


Fixes:
- Fixed Leaderboard display issue
- Fixed bug whereby non-host players could not choose a Flask while in multiplayer
- Fixed issue where a unit no longer receives commands when it gets incapacitated on finishing a channeled ability. (Involved encounters: Ji'loch the Imprisoned)
- Best-case fix for some desyncs.

As always, the leaderboards have been reset each time we move to a new patch. Healing/resurrecting felt a little too strong, hence the changes to the mana costs.
Have fun boss-slaying!

notes.content:
Here's the changelog for NEO Impossible Bosses build 0.06. There's not many gameplay changes for this update, it's mostly a translation and asset update.

Gameplay Changes:
- Boss hitpoint balancing now accounts for attack speed.
- Gold reduction from pausing too much, up to -200 gold.
- Windblessed arrows health bonus set to 200 from 500.
- Camera limit tweaks
- DBM's Flame Charge ability now pushes enemy units.
- The Great Spirit Oak Mother's mass entangling roots ability now has a minor visual rework.
- Ji'loch the Imprisoned Demonic Eruption ability now follows a different pattern.
- New names for bosses!

Other Changes:
- Simplified Chinese is now available.
- Fixed crash when transitioning between replays
- Replays now record text and have a point-of-view system to look from the player's perspective.
- Some audio and visual updates.
- Fixed text input from IME keyboards.
- Many minor text changes.

notes.title: Closed Beta Build 0.05 ChangeLog
notes.content:
Here's the changelog for NEO Impossible Bosses build 0.05.

[b]Major Changes[/b]
- Boss damage rework. Bosses now deal more damage overall.
- Boss scripting sequences adjusted.
- Armor to damage reduction tweaked.
- Mana pools tweaked and increased for all heroes.

[b]Priestess[/b]
Hallowed Heal now takes 2 seconds channeling time, with 1 second cooldown.
Hallowed Heal now heals 1000 from 700.
Healing Spirit now heals 750 from 500.
Holy Nova now heals 800 from 600.

[b]Boss: Ji'loch the Imprisoned[/b]
- Demonic Eruption ability now reworked. 
- Fear Bomb ability now summons multiple fear bombs.

[b]Boss: Twin Frost Elementals[/b]
- Blizzard now spawns 2 blizzards that move around the arena.


[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
- Paladin: Fixed Protection Link armor gain.
- Fixed units being unable to follow commands after being stunned while casting an ability.
- Fixed Victory Text 
- Fixed buying item crash
- Fixed Count Winkus script crash
- Fixed status effect stack restoration (Frostbite)

[b]Item Changes[/b]
- Mana associated items have mana restored/maximum mana  amounts increased
- Steel Cover: Health changed to 400 from 1000
- Grand Helm: Health changed to 200 from 400.
- Holy Cross: Heal Bonus increased to 100 from 75.
- Fairy Charm: Item bonus now reduces 1 second channel time from Hallowed Heal. Heal Bonus increased to 120 from 80. Item is now unique.
- Totemic Mask: Health changed to 500 from 800. Armor decreased to 5 from 6.
- Vindicator's Seal: Damage changed to 20 from 25. Removed ability damage, removed health regeneration. Attack speed set to +0.75 percent.
- Order's Sigil: Health change to 300 from 700, Health Regen set to +25, Armor set to +3, Attack Speed set to +0.75 percent.

As always, the leaderboards have been reset. 

Our future roadmap is:
- Adding some form of guild bank to the game 
- Polishing Boss encounters
- Hard mode abilities/tweaks

Thanks to our testers for the help in balancing the game!

notes.title: Closed Beta Build 0.04 ChangeLog
notes.content:
Here's the changelog for NEO Impossible Bosses build 0.04.

Changes:
- Can no longer reattempt successful encounters in ironman mode
- Taunting targets now works better
- Hero selection UI now shows abilities
- Reworked Balazar the Necromancer encounter, added 3 new abilities, Necrotic Mist, Summon Obelisk and Mist Shifting.
- Reworked Ji'loch the Imprisoned encounter, added 2 new abilities, Summon Flame Pillar and Diabolic Sweep, and reworked how binding works.
- The Great Oak Mother encounter: Added ability 'Nightzone'

Fixes:
- Fixed command queueing via shift-rightclick while using Ranger's Rapidfire ability
- Fixed replay desyncs and various bugs related to selecting units while the major selected unit dies.
- Fixed replay desync issues.

Note that with each new build, the leaderboards will be reset and you will be able to upload scores for the bosses again. 

Contact me on [url=https://discord.gg/MjaJnMh]discord[/url] if you're interested in doing beta testing.

Also, here's an [url=https://www.gamasutra.com/blogs/EdwinFan/20171130/310614/Hitpoint_Balancing_with_many_variables.php]article[/url] on how I do hitpoint balancing within NEO Impossible Bosses, do check it out if you're interested in what goes on within the game!

notes.title: Closed Beta Build 0.02 ChangeLog
notes.content:
Here's the changelog for NEO Impossible Bosses build 0.02.

[b]Fixes[/b]
- Fixed multiplayer issues
- Fixed chatbox issues
- Fixed desync issue not recording queued commands
- Fixed shield vfx
- Fixed some movement & steering issues
- Fixed negative movespeed issues
- No longer updating scores for the initial tutorial boss encounter.

[b]Changes[/b]
- Enemy hitpoint bars are now red
- Some boss abilities that push now bounce players up
- Right-click selection priority for runes
- Item balancing updates; items now have class restrictions
- One-eyed horror boss encounter tweaks, reworked ultimate, + 1 more ability
- Deadly Boss machine encounter tweaks + 2 more abilities
- Count Winkus encounter tweak + 2 more abilities
- Guardian: Sonic clap now taunts every 15 seconds
- Ranger: Item "Glowing Rose" ability upgrade switched to Venom Shot from Rune of Winds. Venom Shot now leaves behind AOE venom clouds with the upgrade.
- Tweaked mana costs of the abilities of many heroes.

[b]Rationale behind the item class restriction change:[/b]
- A player could buy a bunch of high armor upgrades on a priest and essentially tank all the bosses. While amusing, it takes out much of the challenge of the game, hence the changes.

[b]Future roadmap:[/b]
- Reworks on the Necromancer/Demon bosses.
- Further balancing tweaks

Do note that with each new build, the leaderboards will be reset and you will be able to upload scores for the bosses again. Also, hard mode will not be accessible for the moment as it's too much to test.
